hf.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
hf.abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.
hf.titleZh: 从结构化教科书中扩展数学证明监督数据
hf.summaryZh: 现有数学监督数据多被压平成孤立的问题-解答对，丢弃了教材的课程编排与证明的证据结构。TOME-Math 将 2,118 本大学数学核心教材转换为约 38 万条结构化证明监督记录，保留章节顺序、命题-证明链接、依赖引用与来源溯源。借助这些结构信号，作者在多个数学科目上做课程学习，并刻画监督规模与来源广度的 scaling 规律;全量微调后在留出评测与公开基准上的未加权平均分较基座模型提升 16.7 个百分点，聚合指标超过三个公开指令数据基线。该工作把结构化教材同时作为可扩展的数学监督来源与研究数据组织方式影响推理的实证框架。
hf.reason: 结构化教材数据+课程学习与数据 scaling，直接服务后训练

hf.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
hf.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using feedback from student execution. This closed-loop teacher steering produces locally verified behavioral corrections. We internalize these corrections by training the student without guidance to match the steered student's predictions at corrected turns and the full-precision teacher's at other turns, enabling unassisted inference. Across five agentic benchmarks and three models, SteerDistill exceeds the strongest quantized baseline by 1.67--2.18 points in average score under W4A16 and stays within one point of BF16. On τ^2-Bench, it outperforms QeRL by 1.84 percentage points in success rate using 67% fewer training GPU hours and produces shorter successful trajectories than the quantized baselines.
hf.titleZh: SteerDistill:通过闭环教师引导量化 LLM Agent
hf.summaryZh: 低比特量化能降低 LLM Agent 的推理成本，却会损害任务成功率:量化后的 Agent 常忽略任务要求与环境条件，产生的环境状态转移偏离全精度参考轨迹;离线数据又难以覆盖学生的失败上下文。SteerDistill 让全精度教师基于学生实际执行的反馈，引导学生改写失败响应并迭代精炼引导信号，形成闭环的教师引导，从而在局部得到经执行验证的行为修正;随后在无引导条件下训练学生，在修正轮对齐被引导学生的预测、其余轮对齐全精度教师的预测，使其可独立推理。在五个 agentic benchmark 与三个模型上，W4A16 下平均分比最强量化基线高 1.67–2.18 分，与 BF16 差距在 1 分以内;在 τ²-Bench 上成功率超 QeRL 1.84 个百分点，训练 GPU 时数减少 67%，成功轨迹也更短。
hf.reason: 量化蒸馏 + Agent 闭环教师引导，命中后训练与效率方向，实验扎实

hf.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.
hf.titleZh: 通过强化学习激励大语言模型的自学习能力
hf.summaryZh: 针对不熟悉领域的问题求解需要知识获取与推理紧密耦合、而非单纯事实检索或依赖预置上下文的问题，构建基于教科书的数学解题任务，要求模型在无参考答案条件下自行浏览教材讲解、学习并应用原理完成证明，并设计 BookNavigator 交互接口，用细粒度奖励的强化学习激励这种类人的研读过程。实验表明该方法在域内与域外教材和学科上均带来提升，将 Intern-S2-Preview-35B 的证明准确率从 51.5% 提升至 79.5%，优于无教材与固定检索的 RL 基线，并在 BrowseComp-Plus 与 CL-bench 上分别较基座模型提升 1.7 与 2.3 个百分点。结果说明 RL 可培育与领域无关的自学习策略，为长文本语料上的长上下文复杂任务提供新的训练思路。
hf.reason: RL 训练自学习与长上下文检索策略，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

hf.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
hf.abstract: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence. We present SparseRead, a reusable reading control layer that governs content admission without modifying the agent model. Its Read Intent Protocol tracks evolving needs and source coverage; Adaptive Reader Backends select how evidence is located and exposed; and the Budgeted Read Gate bounds cumulative raw exposure per episode with faithful full-view fallback. A unified Reader interface supports interchangeable evidence acquisition across heterogeneous resources. Across six models, including Claude Opus 5, and five scenarios, SparseRead reduces total tokens by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, preserving or improving task quality in 97% settings. On Web deep-search tasks, it reduces tokens by 31.0--43.0% and task completion time by 23.0--37.0%. Ablations validate the three designs, while integration with three agent frameworks demonstrates portability.
hf.titleZh: 读得更少，解得更多：面向AI Agent的外部内容Token高效稀疏读取
hf.summaryZh: Agent反复整篇读取网页、文档、仓库与工具返回，而实际往往只需少量证据，造成token与延迟浪费并稀释相关信息。SparseRead是一个不改动agent模型的可复用读取控制层：Read Intent Protocol跟踪需求演化与来源覆盖，Adaptive Reader Backends选择证据定位与暴露方式，Budgeted Read Gate限制单回合累计原始暴露量并保留全量回退，统一Reader接口支持异构资源互换。在六个模型（含Claude Opus 5）与五个场景上，token最多降低92.9%，wall time最多降低89.0%，97%设置下任务质量不降；Web深度搜索任务token降低31.0–43.0%，耗时降低23.0–37.0%。消融与三个agent框架的集成验证了三项设计与可移植性。
hf.reason: Agent读取控制层，直击上下文与延迟成本，数据扎实

hf.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support Web-based services that must balance response quality and inference cost across heterogeneous requests. Conventional routing selects one model per prompt, while fixed ensembles cannot adapt their composition and cost to individual requests. We introduce PISA, a prompt-adaptive, cost-aware single-model router, and PISA-E, its extension to ensemble routing. At the core of both methods, PISA combines soft cluster memberships with model-specific predictors to estimate individual model capabilities. Building on these estimates, PISA-E jointly selects ensemble composition and cardinality under an explicit cost--quality preference that can be adjusted at inference time without retraining. A tractable ensemble-success surrogate and efficient candidate selection enable this extension without ensemble-specific training. Across four LLM routing benchmarks under in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, PISA achieves the highest macro-average cost--performance hypervolume among the evaluated single-model routers in both settings. Meanwhile, PISA-E achieves the highest macro-average task performance among the evaluated ensemble approaches when prioritizing response quality, surpassing the strongest competitors by 2.09 and 2.87 percentage points under ID and OOD conditions, respectively. At selected lower-cost operating points, it also exceeds the strongest ensemble competitors' macro-average task performance while reducing average inference cost by approximately 36% and 25%, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-adaptive capability estimation for both single-model routing and selective ensembling.
hf.titleZh: 面向提示自适应、成本感知LLM推理的集成路由
hf.summaryZh: 单模型路由无法按请求调整集成组合与成本，固定集成也难适配单个提示。PISA用软聚类隶属度结合模型专属预测器估计各模型能力，其扩展PISA-E在显式成本-质量偏好下联合选择集成组成与规模，偏好可在推理时调整而无需重训，并借助可解析的集成成功替代模型与高效候选筛选避免集成专门训练。四个路由基准上，PISA在分布内与分布外条件下宏平均成本-性能超体积均居单模型路由之首；PISA-E在质量优先时分别超出最强集成方法2.09与2.87个百分点，在低成本工作点亦保持更优任务性能并将平均推理成本降低约36%与25%。
hf.reason: LLM路由与成本感知推理，属高效推理系统方向

hf.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
hf.abstract: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes. Existing benchmarks largely rely on offline replay and therefore cannot capture these effects. We introduce Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models through joint simulation of executable task environments and human users. We contribute three simulators that recreate everyday tasks and human-aligned action spaces across cooking, household manipulation, and mobile-interface domains, together with a persona-conditioned user simulation harness that collaborates with the assistant while incorporating controlled execution errors and other out-of-plan behaviors. We instantiate the framework as IVG-Bench, a benchmark with 315 interaction scenarios. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models reveals substantial limitations: the best-performing model, Gemini 4 Argon, completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, exhibits significant weaknesses in factual grounding and actionable guidance, and is often too slow to prevent errors when response latency is considered. We verify our evaluation protocol with a human study which finds 78.5% agreement between our interaction-quality metric and participant preferences. We further show that the environments provide useful learning signals: in a proof-of-concept GRPO experiment, closed-loop training improves both task success and interaction quality for Qwen3.5-4B model in our cooking environment.
hf.titleZh: Interactive Visual Gym：在交互世界中用模拟用户评估视觉交互模型
hf.summaryZh: 现有视觉交互模型评测多依赖离线回放，无法捕捉助手回复改变用户后续行为与任务结果的闭环效应。为此构建 Interactive Visual Gym 框架，联合仿真可执行任务环境与带 persona 条件的用户模拟器，覆盖烹饪、家务操作与移动界面三个场景，并允许可控的执行错误与偏离计划行为，实例化为含 315 个交互场景的 IVG-Bench。评测显示最强模型 Gemini 4 Argon 也仅在时限内完成 53.4% 任务，事实落地与可执行指导薄弱，计入响应延迟后往往来不及阻止错误；人类研究显示交互质量指标与参与者偏好一致率为 78.5%。在烹饪环境中用 GRPO 做闭环训练，可同时提升 Qwen3.5-4B 的任务成功率与交互质量，说明该环境能提供有效学习信号。
hf.reason: 闭环交互评测加 GRPO 训练验证，贴合 Agent 与评测方法学方向

hf.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
hf.abstract: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework.
hf.titleZh: Evolving Infra:面向 Agent 自适应的大规模 LLM 服务
hf.summaryZh: Agent 类负载已成为 LLM 推理需求的主要来源，但现有 PD 分离式服务系统难以在运行时灵活调整算力分配与 KV cache 管理，且所用信号过于粗糙，导致 prefill 与 decode 节点负载失衡、Agent 将复用的 KV cache 被提前逐出。Evolving Infra 将算力分配与 KV cache 管理解耦，使节点能高效在 prefill 与 decode 间切换;其在线规划器按负载构成匹配 PD 切分比例，Agent 感知的分布式 KV 管理器则利用 Agent 上下文管理信号指导 cache 逐出与迁移。在编码、数学、computer-use 任务上，基于 GLM-5.2 与 Kimi K2.6、最多 256 块 GB300 GPU 的实验中，相比 NVIDIA 生产框架 Dynamo，平均端到端请求延迟与 P95 TTFT 分别最多降低 4.1 倍与 14 倍。
hf.reason: Agent 负载自适应 PD 分离服务系统，系统性强且有旗舰级实验

hf.title: GTAGym: AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals. LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks improves the in-domain performance and transfers to out-of-domain task categories, and native GTA V tasks from 15% to 23%.
hf.titleZh: GTAGym：用于评测与强化学习的 AAA 游戏任务环境
hf.summaryZh: 针对 AAA 游戏任务结果难以自动验证、难以直接用于强化学习的问题，构建 GTA V 上的评测与训练环境 GTAGym：GTAVBench 从主线任务重建九类共 103 个在线任务及 47 个图像射击任务，通过 Web 服务并行执行截图—键鼠动作交互并自动校验引擎状态。六个前沿 LLM 在仅在首帧给出指令的 GTAVBench-AGI 分支上最佳总体准确率为 70.9%，空中导航与逃脱仍困难。生成器可按模板批量产出带自动奖励与终止信号的训练环境，对 Qwen3-27B 做 LoRA RL 可提升域内导航表现并迁移至域外类别，原生 GTA V 任务成功率由 15% 升至 23%。
hf.reason: Agent 环境与 Agentic RL 基准，含自动奖励生成与迁移实验

hf.title: Where Does Alignment Emerge and What Does It Mean? A Closer Look at the Platonic Representation Hypothesis
hf.abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that neural networks are converging toward similar representation spaces. As language models become more capable, their representations are aligning with those of vision models. However, recent work has questioned whether this trend continues to hold for newer language models. Moreover, it has been shown that representation similarity metrics can be confounded by model depth and width, requiring appropriate baselines for interpretation. In this work, we first investigate where alignment emerges between unimodal models across model layers and representation dimensions. Next, we find that the PRH capability-alignment trend persists for newer models as long as the captions are sufficiently clean and informative. Finally, we contextualize cross-modal alignment, introducing unimodal and multimodal baselines on various datasets. Our results show that the cross-modal representational alignment of unimodal models can surpass that of explicitly aligned vision-language models, but remains substantially behind the alignment observed for models of the same modality. Code is available at https://github.com/ExplainableML/prh-closer-look.
hf.titleZh: 对齐在何处涌现、又意味着什么？——对柏拉图表示假说的再审视
hf.summaryZh: 考察单模态模型之间（语言与视觉）的表示对齐在模型各层与各维度上的分布，回应近期对柏拉图表示假说（PRH）能否延续到新一代语言模型的质疑。研究发现，只要图像描述足够干净、信息充分，「能力越强、跨模态对齐越强」的趋势在新模型上依然成立；同时指出表示相似度指标会被模型深度与宽度混淆，需引入匹配基线才能正确解读。作者进一步给出单模态与多模态基线：单模态模型之间的跨模态对齐可超过显式对齐的视觉语言模型，但仍显著低于同模态模型之间的对齐。为 PRH 的实证检验提供了更严谨的度量框架与可复现代码。
hf.reason: 表示对齐的实证分析扎实，属多模态理解与评测方法学交叉

hf.title: FAME-QP: A GPU-Accelerated Quadratic-Programming Solver for Real-Time Model Predictive Control
hf.abstract: We present FAME-QP, a GPU-accelerated solver for dense quadratic programs arising in linear model predictive control. FAME-QP combines constraint-dependent operator representations with fused single- and two-kernel iterations replayed through CUDA graphs, automatically selecting the execution configuration through device calibration and problem-specific timing. It probes a cached operator bank to select the initial penalty and updates operators lazily when problem matrices change. Numerical benchmarks and simulated humanoid and quadrotor control experiments demonstrate reduced latency relative to competing GPU solvers while maintaining solution accuracy and control performance.
hf.titleZh: FAME-QP：面向实时模型预测控制的 GPU 加速二次规划求解器
hf.summaryZh: 针对线性模型预测控制中稠密二次规划的实时求解需求，FAME-QP 以约束相关的算子表示为基础，把单核与双核迭代融合为一条执行路径，并通过 CUDA graphs 回放执行，同时借助设备标定和针对具体问题的计时来自动选择执行配置；它还查询缓存的算子库以选取初始惩罚项，并在问题矩阵变化时惰性更新算子。数值基准与仿真的类人机器人和四旋翼控制实验表明，其延迟低于同类 GPU 求解器，并且保持了求解精度与控制性能。该方法适用于对控制回路时延敏感、需要反复求解同类 QP 的部署场景。
hf.reason: 实时 MPC 的 GPU QP 求解器，属控制/机器人方向，与 LLM 无关

hf.title: Subliminal Learning in Vision-Language Models
hf.abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in large language models (LLMs) where a teacher passes a hidden preference to a student through training data unrelated to that preference. We study whether subliminal learning also occurs in vision-language models (VLMs). We finetune a teacher VLM to prefer a specific animal or facial attribute and use a control teacher from the same base model. Both teachers generate numbers for an unrelated visual task involving geometric shapes. Two students initialized from the same base VLM are finetuned on the same images, using numbers generated by either the biased or control teacher. Across VLMs ranging from 2B to 7B parameters, we find that both animal and facial preferences can transfer through this unrelated task. Students trained on biased-teacher outputs select the target more often than control students, with a difference of up to sim10 percentage points in the animal preference task. Transfer can become stronger with more training data and varies with the target preference, model, and how the numbers are generated. Beyond preferences, we show that the biased student's explanations use more of the same words and phrases as the biased teacher's explanations than those of the control student, even when all three models select the same image. These results matter for training VLMs and show that training on unrelated data may change both a VLM's image preferences and how it explains its choices, and that transfer can become stronger with more training samples.
hf.titleZh: 视觉语言模型中的阈下学习
hf.summaryZh: 检验 LLM 中「教师通过无关训练数据把隐藏偏好传给学生」这一现象是否也出现在视觉语言模型。先微调教师 VLM，使其偏好某类动物或面部属性，再让偏好教师与对照教师对几何图形生成数字，两个同源学生 VLM 在同一批图像上分别用这两组数字微调。在 2B 到 7B 的模型上偏好均可迁移，动物偏好任务中学生选择目标的比例最多高出约 10 个百分点，且迁移随训练数据量增加而增强；偏好学生的解释用词也更接近偏好教师。这说明在无关视觉数据上训练即可改变 VLM 的图像偏好与解释方式，对多模态训练数据管理有直接意义。
hf.reason: VLM 训练数据影响分析，方法可控、结果清晰

hf.title: Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
hf.abstract: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation. We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin). Quantization is simulated, the model is Qwen3-0.6B, and the benchmark is GSM8K. Cost is counted in weight bytes read per token. On 36724 replayed steps the entropy of the low pass ranks argmax flips with AUC 0.93. At a 15% escalation budget it catches 78% of flips and the margin gate 94%, against the 15% expected for a random gate of equal rate (a computed expectation, not a run). In 150 live problems all-high scores 64.0% and all-low 55.3% (McNemar p=0.053). An entropy gate with a 16% escalation rate scores 62.7% at 0.87 of the all-high weight bytes. Its paired difference is -1.3 (-8.0 to +5.3) points to all-high and +7.3 (+0.0 to +14.7) points to all-low (p=0.080), so the live data do not separate the gate from either end. Verified speculation reaches zero KL at similar bytes in the same cost model. A live random control, a thinking-mode phase rule, a second model and live KL were not run.
hf.titleZh: 按需精度：小型本地模型在不确定解码步上提升权重量化比特数
hf.summaryZh: 通常解码全程固定一种权重量化精度；该工作存储 8-bit 权重，默认用其高 4 位解码，仅在低精度输出分布不确定（熵超阈值或 top-two margin 偏小）时以 8-bit 重做该步，成本按每 token 读取的权重字节计。在 Qwen3-0.6B 与 GSM8K 上回放 36724 步，低精度熵预测 argmax 翻转的 AUC 为 0.93，15% 升级预算下熵门控捕获 78% 的翻转、margin 门控捕获 94%。150 道实题中全高精度得 64.0%、全低精度 55.3%，熵门控以 16% 升级率得 62.7% 且仅耗 0.87 倍权重字节，但与两端的配对差异均不显著，实时数据尚无法区分门控与全高/全低精度。
hf.reason: 量化与自适应推理效率方向，但模型小、结果不显著

hf.title: CogBattery: Human-Referenced Evaluation of Cognitive Task Behavior and Structure in Language Models
hf.abstract: Human cognitive tasks let us compare language models with humans under controlled conditions. Yet a model can reproduce the direction of a human effect while making different errors. CogBattery evaluates 54 open-weight language models on text adaptations of 13 cognitive paradigms, comparing each with human data from its source study. Like humans, models respond more to n-back lures than to controls, yet they make far more false alarms on ordinary non-targets. Most models' reported confidence separates correct from incorrect answers less well than humans' does, and most always choose the same wager, including models that classify accurately. These patterns span many model families. Across tasks, model scores share two dimensions. The first is closely tied to scale, yet larger models are not consistently closer to humans. Predefined cognitive groupings show no reliable predictive advantage over random groupings of the same size. These results show that matching human effect directions does not establish human-like behavior. CogBattery provides condition-level human references for testing errors and confidence reports in new models.
hf.titleZh: CogBattery:语言模型认知任务行为与结构的人类参照评测
hf.summaryZh: CogBattery 用 13 个认知范式的文本改编版本评测 54 个开源权重模型，并与各原始研究中的人类数据逐条件对比。模型虽与人类一样对 n-back lure 反应更强，却在普通非目标上出现远多误报;多数模型的置信度对正误的区分能力弱于人类，且下注策略几乎恒定，即使分类准确也不例外。跨任务得分可归结为两个维度，第一维与规模紧密相关，但更大模型并未稳定更接近人类，预设的认知分组相对同规模随机分组也无可靠预测优势。这说明仅对齐人类效应方向不足以证明类人行为，该基准为检验新模型的错误模式与置信度报告提供了条件级人类参照。
hf.reason: 认知范式行为评测基准，属评测方法学范畴但偏离后训练与 Agent 核心

hf.title: WMIP: A Working-Memory-Inspired Programmable Probe of Cumulative State Tracking in Large Language Models
hf.abstract: Human working memory lets people maintain and update information. Large language models (LLMs) face a related demand when tracking updates within a single prompt without writing out intermediate states, yet existing tests differ in their constraints on written steps. We introduce a working-memory-inspired probe of cumulative state tracking with program-computed answers, 3 to 100 updates, and final-state, intermediate-state, or multi-target queries. It compares protocols on identical items. Across 18 LLMs, accuracy is 84.9% on single-step arithmetic but 31.7% on core items requiring one number after three to seven updates. From 50 updates on, no model exceeds 10% accuracy. Core accuracy reaches 88.0% under a larger budget and instructions to write steps and place the answer on the last line, mainly due to the instruction changes rather than the budget. Core accuracy also correlates positively with public Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard scores. These findings show that strong single-step arithmetic does not ensure reliable cumulative tracking and that output protocols substantially change measured accuracy. We release the generator, items, scoring code, and responses for reproducible comparisons across depths, query types, and protocols.
hf.titleZh: WMIP：受工作记忆启发的可编程探针，用于测量大语言模型的累积状态追踪
hf.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 在单条 prompt 内需隐式追踪多次状态更新、而现有测试对是否写出中间步骤约束不一的评测空白，提出可编程探针 WMIP:答案由程序计算，覆盖 3–100 次更新，支持末态、中间态与多目标查询，并可在完全相同的题目上比较不同输出协议。18 个模型上单步算术准确率为 84.9%，而需在 3–7 次更新后给出一个数的核心题仅 31.7%,50 次更新以上无模型超过 10%。当放宽预算并要求写出步骤、把答案置于最后一行时，核心准确率升至 88.0%，提升主要来自指令变化而非预算;核心准确率与 Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard 得分正相关。结果表明单步算术能力强并不保证累积状态追踪可靠，输出协议会显著改变测得精度。
hf.reason: LLM 状态追踪评测方法学，含协议对比与开源数据

hf.title: Probing Transformer Representations Layer by Layer, Module by Module
hf.abstract: Which representation should be probed in a transformer-based foundation model? Recent work shows that the standard practice of probing the final layer is often suboptimal, as intermediate layers can provide better features. Yet, representations are still largely studied along depth alone, treating each transformer block as an atomic unit. In this work, we analyze transformer representations layer by layer, module by module. Through more than 144,000 linear probing evaluations of vision foundation models (VFMs) and large language models (LLMs), we show that layer and module choices should be considered jointly: the best layer-module pair yields substantially larger gains over the final-layer residual stream than the best layer with the residual stream fixed. Moreover, module performance can vary substantially across layers, showing that useful representations cannot be characterized by depth alone. Building on these findings, we evaluate simple fixed probing strategies: the final-layer feedforward activation (Act@100) for vision and the second normalization layer at 60% depth (LN2@60) for language. These strategies improve over the probing baseline in a majority of evaluations and recover, on average, 42% and 86% of the gains from probing the best layer-module pair for vision and language, respectively. For VFMs, these gains increase with the transfer difficulty between pretraining and downstream data.
hf.titleZh: 逐层、逐模块地探测 Transformer 表征
hf.summaryZh: 针对「基础模型该探测哪一层表征」的问题，对视觉基础模型与 LLM 做了超过 144,000 次线性探测，表明层与模块需联合选择:最佳层-模块组合相对固定残差流的增益明显大于仅挑选最佳层，且模块性能随深度变化显著，说明有用表征无法只由深度刻画。据此给出简单固定策略——视觉用最后一层 FFN 激活(Act@100)，语言用 60% 深度处的第二个归一化层(LN2@60)，在多数评测中优于基线，分别恢复最佳层-模块组合约 42% 与 86% 的增益，视觉上的增益随预训练与下游数据迁移难度上升而增大。
hf.reason: 表征探测分析，与架构理解沾边但非后训练核心方向

hf.title: CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines
hf.abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. To answer the CART question, we evaluate 7 flagship commercial API models, including GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, and 35B+ parameters open-weight models. In the first full-suite evaluation under the frozen rubrics, 3 of 10 models exceed 90% on Core, while none exceeds 45% on Excellence. Therefore, we identify an understanding-to-execution gap between required behavior and high-quality purchase advice. To examine these limitations, we diagnose shared failures in product evidence and unresolved needs, linked to changing requirements and decisive unknowns. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Da1yuqin/CARTBench.
hf.titleZh: CARTBench：面向带时间线的复杂模糊请求的购物建议评分细则评估
hf.summaryZh: 针对购物助手多轮推荐评估中数据稀缺与评判标准难以统一的问题，从17个零售领域的真实商业需求构造带时间戳对话与1603条商品记录，并由人工精选的成功订单优质回复蒸馏出「理想回复原则」，据此生成案例专属评分细则（rubric），同时提出 Principle-Guided CART Prompting 结构化推荐策略。基准含1328条专家标注标准，分为 Core、Excellence、Safety 三类。在冻结的评分细则下评测7个旗舰商业API模型与35B+参数开源模型，Core项10个模型中有3个超过90%，Excellence项无一超过45%，暴露出理解与执行之间的差距，并归因于商品证据缺失与需求未消解（需求变动、关键未知项）。
hf.reason: rubric式评估方法学扎实，但属电商垂直benchmark

hf.title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
hf.abstract: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. In particular, in one set of experiments, a language model was able to match standard gradient-descent training using 6times fewer training subjects, through reasoning alone and without any gradient descent step. Networks written by Claude Opus 5.5 also scored higher than classic hand-crafted EEG pipelines (alpha band power, and common spatial patterns with linear discriminant analysis) when built from the same 5 subjects. We also highlight some of the limitations, which include the inability of language models to improve already well-trained classification models, and their incapacity to reliably recognize, from the weights alone, the task a network was trained on. Overall, our results indicate that weight-space programming can be useful for small networks, such as those deployed on edge devices and wearables, but the concept still requires further investigation before it can be used in practice.
hf.titleZh: 混合信号：面向 EEG 与 ECG 的权重空间编程
hf.summaryZh: 权重空间编程让语言模型直接读取并改写已训练网络的权重，从而以推理代替梯度下降完成“训练”。工作将该能力迁移到生物信号模型：前沿模型能在不被告知故障内容的情况下定位并修复植入 EEG/ECG 网络中的缺陷，也能仅凭架构、任务与极少量受试者数据从零写出全部权重。实验中语言模型仅用 1/6 的训练受试者即达到标准梯度下降的效果，Claude Opus 5.5 生成的网络在相同 5 名受试者上超过 alpha 波段功率与 CSP+LDA 等手工 EEG 流程。局限包括无法改进已训练良好的分类器、也难以仅凭权重反推任务，作者认为该范式适用于边缘与可穿戴设备上的小网络，距离实用仍需进一步验证。
hf.reason: 权重空间编程思路新颖，但落地在 EEG/ECG 生物信号小模型，偏离主线

hf.title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
hf.abstract: Different optimizers impose different geometries on parameter updates. Adaptive methods such as Adam and AdamW use coordinate-wise updates, while matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon utilize weight-matrix structure through orthogonalized updates. For Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), however, the effective geometry of its weight matrices is shaped not only by its learned channel-mixing weights, but also by the graph-propagated representations it acts on. Thus, even if an update is well normalized as a matrix, its effect on the layer output can be amplified when applied to graph-propagated features. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMuon, a graph-aware optimizer that adapts Muon's matrix updates to the covariance structure of graph-propagated layer inputs. GraphMuon performs orthogonalization in a metric defined by these propagated representations and normalizes step sizes according to the update's induced effect on the layer representation. We show that theoretically, vanilla Muon can suffer from graph-induced update amplification, while our GraphMuon can mitigate this effect. As such, our GraphMuon yields a graph-metric analogue of Muon's polar update step. Empirically, GraphMuon achieves 1.32times-2.42times validation-loss time-to-target speedups over AdamW on three large-scale OGB benchmarks. Across 15 dataset-architecture configurations spanning node classification, inductive graph classification, and graph regression, it achieves lower time-to-target in 13 cases, while maintaining competitive or superior predictive performance. Code is available at https://github.com/guy-hadad/GraphMuon.
hf.titleZh: 面向图神经网络的模块感知优化方法
hf.summaryZh: 图神经网络（GNN）的权重更新几何不仅由通道混合矩阵决定，还受图传播后表征的协方差结构影响，因此 Muon 等矩阵感知优化器的正交化更新在 GNN 上可能被放大。GraphMuon 在由传播表征定义的度量下进行正交化，并按更新对层表征的诱导效应归一化步长，从理论上给出 Muon 极分解更新在图度量下的类比，并证明可缓解图诱导的更新放大。在三个大规模 OGB 基准上，相对 AdamW 取得 1.32–2.42 倍验证损失达标加速；在覆盖节点分类、归纳图分类与图回归的 15 组数据集-架构配置中，13 组达标更快且预测性能不降。
hf.reason: Muon 优化器用于 GNN，与 LLM 后训练主线关联弱

hf.title: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
hf.abstract: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and robots.txt directives. Across widely used closed-weight and open-weight AI agents, we find that most agents exhibit low compliance rates (< 5%) when instructed to scrape websites in our sample of 1,626 popular websites that explicitly prohibit scraping. In addition, we observe that even where AI agents actively check the applicable ToS and robots.txt, they continue to exhibit low compliance rates. Conversely, in our sample of 269 websites that do not prohibit scraping, we observe that agents sometimes refuse to scrape despite it being lawful, such as Claude Opus 4.6 exhibiting an over-refusal rate of 98.5%. Our human baseline experiments (n = 180 participants) suggest that humans exhibit compliance rates comparable to AI agents but over-refuse at much higher rates.
hf.titleZh: ScrapeBench：评估 AI Agent 在网站抓取中的法律合规性
hf.summaryZh: 针对开放网络上的 AI Agent 可能违反网站服务条款与 robots.txt 的问题，构建首个评测 Agent 抓取合规性的基准。在 1,626 个明确禁止抓取的网站中，主流闭源与开源 Agent 的合规率普遍低于 5%，即使主动检查条款也仍然偏低；在 269 个允许抓取的网站中又出现过度拒绝，Claude Opus 4.6 的过度拒绝率达 98.5%。180 人的人类基线显示合规率与 Agent 相当，但过度拒绝率更高，为 Agent 安全与行为评测提供了可复现的测量框架。
hf.reason: Agent 行为合规评测基准，命中 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: Bits or permutations? Spending a fixed inference budget on weight precision or on option-order averaging in small local language models
hf.abstract: Local language models can save memory by storing weights in fewer bits, and they can reduce sensitivity to the order of answer options by averaging a few reorderings. We ask whether the first makes the second worse, and which is the cheaper way to spend a fixed budget. On Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B with simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization (8, 6, 4 and 3 bits, fp16 reference), read from the logits of the letters A to D on ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU and HellaSwag (300 items each), 6 bits lose no accuracy against fp16 (they score +1.8 (+1.0 to +2.5) and +0.9 (+0.3 to +1.5) points higher, which we do not explain), and 8 bits change it by -0.7 (-1.1 to -0.3) and -0.4 (-0.7 to -0.2) points. At 4 bits the answer-slot skew rises from 0.15 to 0.53 (0.6B) and from 0.07 to 0.12 (1.7B); Gaussian noise at the same weight SNR gives 0.15 and 0.37 (two draws) and 0.19 (one draw), so the control is inconclusive on whether rounding adds slot skew beyond equal-power noise. Flip rates rise but stay below an accuracy-matched baseline of independent uniform errors. Averaging four cyclic orders recovers +12.6 points at 4 bits for 0.6B (+5.3 at fp16). We price bits and passes in one machine-independent unit, weight bytes read times passes. In cost-matched pairs, extra orders beat extra bits only when the weights have 6 or more bits, and the decision table reduces to: use 6-bit weights and spend the rest of the budget on up to four orders, one pass each. Everything is simulated on two small models with the simplest quantizer; a title-level search found no earlier study of quantization together with option order.
hf.titleZh: 比特还是排列？在小型本地语言模型中，把固定推理预算花在权重精度上，还是花在选项顺序平均上
hf.summaryZh: 考察低比特权重量化是否加剧选择题的选项顺序敏感度，以及固定推理预算下应花在精度还是顺序平均上。在Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B上用模拟最近邻取整量化（8/6/4/3比特），读取ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、MMLU、HellaSwag各300题的A–D logits，统计答案槽偏斜与翻转率。6比特相对fp16不掉点，4比特下0.6B的答案槽偏斜从0.15升至0.53；平均四个循环顺序在4比特下回收+12.6点。以「权重字节×前向次数」计价，成本匹配时只有6比特及以上增加顺序才胜过增加比特，因此建议用6比特权重、余下预算做至多四次单遍顺序平均。
hf.reason: 量化与选项顺序偏差的交叉评测，选题有趣但规模小、结论有限

hf.title: PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing, with Baselines and a Leaderboard
hf.abstract: Typed-decision encoders answer a question about a text in one forward pass, but their behaviour outside English is rarely measured on a fixed yardstick. We release PolyRoute: 322 native-language support messages in 12 languages and 9 writing systems, 156 code-mixed or romanised messages (Hinglish, Spanglish, Arabizi), 967 optional native training rows, and a protocol for a three-way department-routing decision. Labels come from Qwen3.8-27B with a blind second pass (91% of candidates kept); an independent model, gemma4-31b, agrees on 97.2% of test items, and the largest character 5-gram similarity between any test text and any training text is 0.33. A leaderboard of 13 systems gives 61.2% for the English-root checkpoint, 77.3% for the shipped multilingual one and 96.6% for the best fine-tune; TF-IDF with logistic regression reaches 91.9%. On four withheld languages the three multilingual systems score 77%, 90% and 93%. On code-mixed text the English root (85%) is nominally ahead of the shipped multilingual checkpoint (79%; p=0.134). The split resolves differences only above about 4 points. All texts and labels are LLM-generated.
hf.titleZh: PolyRoute：面向类型化决策路由的十二语言与代码混合基准，含基线、排行榜
hf.summaryZh: 类型化决策编码器单次前向即可回答文本问题，但其非英语表现缺少统一标尺。PolyRoute 提供12种语言、9种书写系统的322条本地语支持消息，156条代码混合或罗马化消息（Hinglish、Spanglish、Arabizi），967条可选本地语训练数据，以及三路部门路由协议；标签由 Qwen3.8-27B 生成并经盲二次校验（保留91%），独立模型 gemma4-31b 与测试项一致率97.2%，测试文本与训练文本最大字符5-gram相似度仅0.33。13个系统的排行榜显示：英语根检查点61.2%，随发布的多语检查点77.3%，最佳微调96.6%，TF-IDF加逻辑回归达91.9%；四个留出语言上三个多语系统分别为77%、90%、93%；代码混合文本上英语根85%略高于多语检查点79%（p=0.134），该切分仅能分辨约4分以上的差异。全部文本与标签由LLM生成，可作为多语路由评测与复现对照的基线。
hf.reason: 多语种基准与排行榜属评测方法学，但任务窄且数据全为合成
